description: The Excel Format Cells experience on a plain Svelte 5 SvGrid. Select a range and apply Currency, Percent, Thousands, Number, Date or General; only the rendering changes while the stored value and every formula stay untouched. HyperFormula keeps Gross profit, Margin and the Total column live, so a computed percentage formats exactly like a typed number.
keywords: svelte 5 grid format cells currency percent

faq.question: How is the format applied to a selection?
faq.answer: The toolbar reads api.getSelected() for the rectangles and writes a format name into a per-cell map. The cell snippet looks up the map and runs the value through toLocaleString with the matching currency, percent or number options for display.

faq.question: Does formatting change the value?
faq.answer: No. The raw value and any formula stay as typed; only the rendered text changes, which is why a formula result and a literal can share one format.

faq.question: Can I add my own format?
faq.answer: Yes. Add a name and a formatter function to the map the snippet consults; the toolbar button is one more entry.
